scope: one outstanding acknowledged public editor update with coalescing and truthful pending-save state
limitations: Confirmed Yjs copy is in-memory only; no durable browser outbox or automatic reconnect/replay
Connection loss after commit but before confirmation remains uncertain; export and explicit reopen are required
Server bounds remain unchanged; accumulated updates above 64 KiB pause instead of silently splitting or dropping edits
Public server confirmation is not independent delivery proof or private MLS/device authority
Signed fixture OIDC/PGlite/local TLS browser evidence does not establish cloud production or fleet-scale acceptance
Managed local Chrome blocks standalone file URLs; pinned CI must still pass the complete browser suite
